# Yin Yoga with Katie

> Free full-length Yin Yoga classes, an illustrated pose guide, and guided follow-along routines, taught by Katie McGrath — gentle, unhurried practice for tired minds and bodies.

Yin Yoga with Katie is a free library of full-length yin yoga classes, a pose reference guide, and guided routines with a built-in hold timer. Classes hold poses at roughly 60–80% of capacity — a real stretch, never forced — and content is grounded in Bernie Clark's *The Complete Guide to Yin Yoga*. Everything on the site is free; a two-hour retreat class is offered by email for anyone who wants to begin with a longer practice.

## Library

- [Full class library](https://yinyogawithkatie.com/videos): every full-length class, filterable by focus area, length and level
- [Pose guide](https://yinyogawithkatie.com/poses): illustrated reference for individual yin poses — how to do it, hold time, target areas, benefits, cautions, transitions
- [Guided routines](https://yinyogawithkatie.com/routines): follow-along sequences of poses with a built-in practice timer
- [The Journal](https://yinyogawithkatie.com/blog): articles on yin yoga practice, philosophy and technique

- [About Katie](https://yinyogawithkatie.com/about): teacher bio and teaching philosophy — trained at the Arhanta Yoga Ashram, teaching since 2018, based in Taipei
